dialogs.about: 손자가 학교에서 배운 법 이야기를 할머니에게 해요

lines.en: Grandma, we learned about the court today.
lines.ko: 할머니, 오늘 학교에서 법원에 대해 배웠어요.

lines.en: Oh, that's interesting. What is a judge?
A judge listens and is always fair.
That is a good word. What is a witness?
A witness tells what he saw.
I see. Did your teacher give you work?
Yes. I must write about one law.
lines.ko: 네. 법 하나에 대해 써야 해요.

lines.en: Will you finish it before dinner?
lines.ko: 저녁 먹기 전에 다 할 거예요?

lines.en: Yes. Grandma, will you allow one short game?
lines.ko: 네. 할머니, 짧게 한 판만 놀아도 돼요?

lines.en: Of course. Finish your school work after that, please.

dialogs.about: 시장 안내 창구에서 작은 가게 허가증을 물어요

lines.en: Hello. My daughter needs a small permit.
I see. What kind of shop is it?
A small flower shop near the market.
Good. We will allow that on this street.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이 거리에서는 허락해 드릴 거예요.

lines.en: Is it illegal to sell outside the door?
Yes, the rules forbid that, Ma'am.
I understand. Is there a penalty for it?
A small penalty, but the rule is fair.
Thank you. When did the rule start?
It started last spring, and it works well.
